note: Namibia: a foreign national intending to work must obtain the appropriate authorisation before arriving (Immigration Control Act 1993, s. 27), whatever the industry or the engagement's length; a temporary engagement, a single performance included, takes the short-term employment permit (the Ministry of Home Affairs' spokesperson, August 2026). No days without it.

sources.title: The Namibian, Foreign artists need permits before performing in Namibia (18 August 2026)
sources.said: The ministry spokesperson Margaret Kalo said Section 27 of the Immigration Control Act of 1993 requires foreign nationals intending to work, conduct business or practice a profession in Namibia to obtain the appropriate visa authorisation. ... “Where the engagement is of a temporary nature, a short-term employment permit is required,” Kalo says.
